facts.claim: Viking Star (Viking): Entered service 2015; 47,800 GT; 930 guests (lower berth / double occupancy); 227 m length; Star class.
MV Viking Star is the lead ship of the Viking Star class of cruise ships, and the first such ship operated by Viking Ocean Cruises, a division of Viking Cruises.
Two Viking Star-class sister ships, Viking Sea and Viking Sky, joined her in the Viking Ocean Cruises fleet in 2016.
